The autospec store and the snapshot name sealed-evidence are real artifacts published at one snapshot, followed by a later head, so a read at the head instead of the condition's snapshot is a different call. The old call_args checks are calls observed with sys.monitoring (engine_lifecycle.ObservedCalls), nothing replaced: the evaluation_context _dispatchable actually passed to _selected_action_current (its read_artifact returns the bytes, its validate_artifact is callable), and every evidence-reader call and every ResearchRepository.read call the judgments made names (path, condition snapshot). Each judgment gets an artifact no judgment has matched yet, because a matched digest's verdict is remembered and its bytes are not read again: readiness reads one, the dispatch judgment reads another. A refused digest is read and refused by readiness (evaluation_error, artifact bytes differ from sealed hash) and by the dispatch judgment's readiness check, which then stops before _selected_action_current. Reads are observed at the repository, where the old test observed them, not at the Git port: this process published the artifacts, and the repository serves bytes it published from its own process cache without the port.

legacy.reason: The Sim tests run every path engine._call_steps was cut into (1c), each measured with coverage on one test after the Sim template was built. Preparation (call_engine._prepare_call), the start notice (_call_started) and the stop judgment (_call_stop_requested): sim.test_call_stop_flags.PreparationStopTests.test_pause_publishes_a_stop and the other fifteen tests of sim.test_call_stop_flags, which start the call through _call_steps and judge one stop reason each. The result receipt (_receive_call) and the whole generator through the scheduler, runner, worker and model double: sim.test_lifecycle_engine_controls.PausedDispatchTests.test_scheduler_scopes_maintenance_dispatch_with_executor_double and flows.test_activation.PublicActivationTests.test_public_activation_reaches_active_through_the_worker_with_all_time_from_the_clock_port. The characterization fixed the current state digests of one scenario as its expectation (past P2 risk) and was skipped on checkouts whose prompt documents differ in line endings; its recorded trace file goes with it.
